description:
Route the last hand-written type-label extraction through the shared extractor and give process-group liveness the one probe that PID liveness uses, closing the `one-form-convergence` story checkpoint findings from its sol review.

## Background

- `crates/jit/tests/fast_docs_templates/template_apply_tests.rs` defines `type_of`, which parses each label with `parse_label` and compares its namespace to the literal `"type"`. `crates/jit/src/labels.rs` owns that extraction (`type_label_value`), and `b0dc019f` already moved the four prefix-based sites onto it.
- `crates/jit/tests/cli_repo_workflow/serve_cli_tests.rs` defines `process_group_survives(pgid)`, a second signal-zero probe that maps `ESRCH` to dead and every other result to alive. That errno policy is `probe_result_is_alive` in `crates/jit/src/process.rs`, which exposes only `is_alive(pid)` (`pub(crate)`) and the guards `checked_pid` and `process_group_target`.
- Invoker ruling (just-in-time-d5): one private probe over an already-guarded `kill(2)` target, with both guards the only way in (@/inv/pid-safety).
- Epic criterion: `b697a3f7` REQ-20 (process liveness as one guarded primitive with one non-unix policy; type extraction from labels has one normalisation); story `dfb2f10d` REQ-02.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `type_of` in `template_apply_tests.rs` delegates to `jit::labels::type_label_value`, or its callers use the extractor directly.
- [hard] REQ-02: No code under `crates/` outside `labels.rs` extracts a type label by comparing a parsed namespace to `"type"` or by handling the `type:` prefix.
- [hard] REQ-03: `process.rs` has one private probe taking an already-guarded `i32` `kill(2)` target. On unix it applies `probe_result_is_alive`; on non-unix it holds the one policy, "an accepted target is alive". It is the module's only signal-zero `kill` call and the only match on its errno.
- [hard] REQ-04: `is_alive(pid)` is `checked_pid(pid)` followed by the probe, and the new `pub fn is_group_alive(pgid: u32) -> bool` is `process_group_target(pgid)` followed by the probe.
- [hard] REQ-05: Unit tests in `process.rs` own the probe policy and the group guard's refusals of pgid 0, 1 and `u32::MAX`.
- [hard] REQ-06: `serve_cli_tests.rs` drops `process_group_survives` and calls `jit::process::is_group_alive`, without re-proving the errno policy. `kill_process_group` stays as it is.
title: Type-label extraction and process-group liveness each go through their one shared form
